errors.text_span: 该饼图展示了在“男性动词语义域分布”中各类动词语义范畴的占比情况
errors.evidence: The figure is described as a single pie chart, but it actually consists of two connected charts. The pie chart on the right is a breakdown of the '其他' (Other) slice from the pie chart on the left.

errors.text_span: 具体而言，最大的切片为“物态事态”，占比23.4%，颜色为浅粉色；紧随其后的是“生活工作”，占比23.3%，颜色为浅蓝色；“其他”类别占比19.38%，颜色为浅灰色；“生产”占比16.91%，颜色为绿色；“身体动作”占比9.9%，颜色为深蓝色；“心理活动”占比10.64%，颜色为深紫色；“争斗”占比9.57%，颜色为深红色；“帮助”占比4.26%，颜色为橙色；“表情”占比5.32%，颜色为浅橙色；“方位改变”占比18.09%，颜色为橙红色；“际遇”占比5.32%，颜色为深棕色；“交通”占比4.26%，颜色为浅蓝色；“判断”占比8.51%，颜色为浅灰色；“司法”占比10.64%，颜色为深灰色；“文教”占比5.57%，颜色为深蓝色；“战争”占比8.87%，颜色为深红色；“生理活动”占比9.48%，颜色为深蓝色。
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists all categories from both pie charts as if they belong to a single chart. This misrepresents the data structure, as the categories on the right are a sub-division of the '其他' (Other) category from the left chart.
The color for the '其他' (Other) category, which has a value of 19.38%, is described as light gray. In the chart, it is medium blue.
The color for '身体动作' (Body movement) is described as deep blue. In the chart, this category is colored a medium-light blue, while '生理活动' (Physiological activity) is deep blue.
The color for '争斗' (Struggle) is described as deep red. In the chart, this category is colored dark magenta/purple.
The color for '交通' (Traffic/transportation) is described as light blue. In the chart, this category is colored light blue-green/cyan.
The color for '判断' (Judgment) is described as light gray. In the chart, this category is colored light blue-green/cyan.
The color for '文教' (Culture and education) is described as deep blue. In the chart, this category is colored dark purplish-gray.

errors.text_span: 整体来看，切片按大小顺序排列
errors.evidence: The description claims the slices are arranged by size, but this is visibly false. In both charts, the slices are not sorted in any particular order based on their percentage values.
